name: next-steps
description: After each turn, suggests up to three next prompts above the input. Press 1, 2 or 3 to add one to the prompt box as a draft (pick several to combine them), 0 to dismiss, /next to show the last suggestions again. Sending just numbers (3, 1,2, 12, or 9 for all; from a phone through Heeler) sends those suggestions.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.

printSuggestions.title: Print suggestions in the transcript
printSuggestions.description: Also print each new list as text lines in the transcript, so a remote view of the terminal (Heeler) can read and copy them.

cacheCheckTokens.title: Cache write that turns low effort off
cacheCheckTokens.description: After each suggestion request, a cache write this many tokens or larger, and larger than the cache read, means low effort made a second cache copy of the conversation; low effort then stays off for the session.
